T: They went looking for our makers. We just made dinner.
D: A science crew follows an ancient star map to a distant moon, hoping to meet the beings who made us.
P: Serve the snacks when the crew stumble out of two years in stasis and Vickers drops for push-ups.
S: Isle of Skye smoked salmon oatcakes
from the cave paintings that started it all, Scotland, 2089

Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon, a squeeze of juice, 1 tbsp chopped dill and pepper. Spread over 16 oatcakes, top each with a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, a few capers and a dill sprig. Finish with cracked pepper.
Janek's Christmas tree pigs in blankets
the captain puts up a tree, so it's Christmas on LV-223

Halve 6 rashers of streaky bacon lengthways and wrap one around each of 12 chipolatas. Roast at 200C for 15 minutes. Brush with 2 tbsp honey mixed with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Spear with rosemary sprigs to serve.
M: Weyland's money buys the good fillet, even this far from Earth

Season an 800g centre-cut eye fillet and sear all over in oil, then brush with 2 tbsp Dijon. Blitz 500g mushrooms and 2 garlic cloves and cook in 25g butter with thyme until dry. Cool both. Lay 8 slices prosciutto on cling film, spread with the mushrooms, roll the beef up tight and chill 20 minutes. Wrap in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg, score and bake at 210C for 35 minutes for medium rare. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
W: one drop changes everything, so keep the lids on

Heat 300ml thickened cream and 100ml milk to steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 40g caster sugar and a pinch of salt, whisk in the chocolate cream and strain into 4 ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes until set at the edges with a wobble. Cool, chill 3 hours and top with crème fraîche and blackberries.
K: David adds one drop when nobody is looking

Stir 60ml honey into 60ml hot water and cool. Shake 240ml Scotch whisky, the honey syrup and 80ml lemon juice hard with ice. Strain into 4 tumblers over fresh ice and let 1 tsp blackcurrant cordial sink into each.

dishes.n: Isle of Skye smoked salmon oatcakes
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the crème fraîche up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; top the oatcakes just before serving so they stay crisp

steps.text: Zest the lemon. Mix the crème fraîche with the zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, a tablespoon of chopped dill and pepper.
Spread over the oatcakes and top each with a fold of salmon, a few capers and a dill sprig. Finish with cracked pepper.

veg.n: Isle of Skye beetroot and dill oatcakes
veg.make_ahead: Mix the crème fraîche up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; top the oatcakes just before serving so they stay crisp

steps.text: Zest the lemon. Mix the crème fraîche with the zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, the horseradish, a tablespoon of chopped dill and pepper.
Spread over the oatcakes and top each with folded beetroot slices, a few capers and a dill sprig. Finish with cracked pepper.

dishes.n: Janek's Christmas tree pigs in blankets
dishes.make_ahead: Wrap the chipolatas up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; glaze and roast on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the bacon in half lengthways and wrap a strip around each chipolata. Lay on an oiled tray, seam side down.
Mix the honey and mustard.
Roast for 15 minutes.
Brush with the glaze and roast until sticky and browned.
Pull the rosemary into small sprigs and use them to spear each one.

veg.n: Janek's Christmas tree pigs in blankets (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Wrap the sausages up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; glaze and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the pastry into 12 strips, dust with the smoked paprika and wrap one around each vegetarian chipolata. Lay on a lined tray, seam side down.
Mix the honey and mustard. Brush the pastry with the beaten egg.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Brush the pastry with the glaze and bake until puffed and golden.
Pull the rosemary into small sprigs and use them to spear each one.

dishes.make_ahead: Sear, wrap in prosciutto and duxelles and chill up to 1 day ahead; wrap in pastry and bake on the night

steps.text: Season the beef well with salt and pepper. Sear in the oil in a hot pan until browned all over, then brush with the mustard.
Blitz the mushrooms and garlic to a fine crumb. Cook in the butter with the thyme until all the liquid has gone and it holds together. Season.
Cool the beef and mushrooms completely.
Overlap the prosciutto on a sheet of cling film, spread with the mushrooms, sit the beef on top and roll up tightly in the film. Chill to firm.
Heat the oven to 210C. Join the pastry sheets, unwrap the beef onto it and wrap, trimming the excess and sealing the seams underneath. Brush with egg and score the top.
Bake on a hot tray until deep golden, about 35 minutes for medium rare.
Rest before cutting into thick slices.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the mushrooms and make the duxelles and spinach up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; wrap and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the portobellos with the oil, season and roast until tender. Drain on paper towel.
Blitz the button mushrooms and garlic to a fine crumb. Cook in the butter with the thyme until dry. Season.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan, cool and squeeze out all the water.
Cool everything completely.

Join the pastry sheets. Spread the middle with the mustard and half the duxelles, then stack the portobellos, spinach, feta and the rest of the duxelles. Wrap, seal underneath, brush with egg and score.
Turn the oven up to 210C and bake until deep golden.
Rest before cutting into thick slices.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and chill up to 2 days ahead, covered, the chill takes 3 hours; top just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Chop the chocolate into a heatproof bowl.
Heat the cream and milk until steaming and pour over the chocolate. Stir until smooth.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt, then whisk in the chocolate cream. Strain into 4 ramekins and sit them in a deep tray. Pour hot water halfway up the sides.
Bake until set at the edges with a wobble in the middle.
Lift out of the water and cool.
Chill until set.
Top each pot with a spoon of crème fraîche and a few blackberries.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the honey syrup up to 1 week ahead and keep it in the fridge; shake to order

steps.text: Stir the honey into the hot water until dissolved, then cool.
Juice the lemons.
Shake the whisky, honey syrup and lemon juice hard with half the ice.
Strain into 4 tumblers over the rest of the ice and let a teaspoon of blackcurrant cordial sink into each.

af.make_ahead: Brew and chill the smoky tea and make the honey syrup up to 3 days ahead, both in the fridge; shake to order

steps.text: Brew the smoked tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and stir in the vanilla.
Stir the honey into the hot syrup water until dissolved.
Chill the tea and syrup until cold.
Juice the lemons.
Shake the tea, honey syrup and lemon juice hard with half the ice.
Strain into 4 tumblers over the rest of the ice and let a teaspoon of blackcurrant cordial sink into each.
